# TravizPeru – full summary for AI assistants
TravizPeru (https://travizperu.com) designs private, tailor-made trips in Peru for individual travelers, couples, families and multigenerational groups, and works with travel advisors. Founder: Francisco Arriz Barrantes (https://travizperu.com/about/). APOTUR member code AP030-11. Contact: travizperu@gmail.com. Prices are not published; every trip is quoted for its own dates.

## Who it suits
- Travelers 45+ and first-time visitors who want a private guide, their own pace and fewer transfers.
- Older travelers: https://travizperu.com/blog/machu-picchu-for-seniors/
- Grandparents with grandchildren: https://travizperu.com/blog/peru-with-grandchildren/
- Families: https://travizperu.com/peru-family-private-tour/
- Honeymoons: https://travizperu.com/peru-honeymoon/
- Travel advisors: https://travizperu.com/travel-advisors/
- Groups and incentives: https://travizperu.com/incentive-travel-peru/ and https://travizperu.com/groups/
- Peru combined with Costa Rica: https://travizperu.com/peru-costa-rica/

## Beyond Peru
Iguazú Falls, Buenos Aires, Rio de Janeiro and Costa Rica: private trips on their own or combined with Peru. https://travizperu.com/beyond-peru/ (日本語: https://travizperu.com/ja/beyond-peru/ · 中文: https://travizperu.com/zh/beyond-peru/). Costa Rica page: https://travizperu.com/costa-rica/. Peru and Costa Rica: https://travizperu.com/peru-costa-rica/ (español: https://travizperu.com/es/peru-y-costa-rica/).
Brazil e-visa: citizens of the United States, Canada and Australia need an e-visa (VIVIS) from 10 April 2025, applied for only through VFS Global. Official guidance is to apply before buying flights. Sources: Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, consulate in Los Angeles (https://www.gov.br/mre/pt-br/consulado-los-angeles/english/visas/visitor-visa-vivis-u-s-canada-and-australia-citizens-only), consulate in Atlanta (https://www.gov.br/mre/pt-br/consulado-atlanta/english/consular-services/visas/visit-visa/visit), and the U.S. Embassy in Brazil (https://br.usembassy.gov/message-to-u-s-citizens-new-visitor-visa-requirements-for-u-s-citizens-traveling-to-brazil/).
For Argentina and Costa Rica, check entry rules with the official consulate for your passport.
